cards.label: ENTP / ENTJ
cards.description: Idea-forward, decisive, and big picture thinkers who love challenging the status quo and driving results.

squares.text: I jump to the “best idea” and skip shared alignment.
squares.try: Try: ask “What decision are we making?”

squares.text: I debate to refine thinking, but it lands as criticism.
squares.try: Try: open with intent + ask 2 questions first.

squares.text: I talk in concepts and people leave unclear on next steps.
I move fast and others feel left behind.
I dismiss details that protect delivery.
I sound certain when I’m still exploring.
I prioritise efficiency over relationships.
squares.try: Try: add one line on people impact.

squares.text: I challenge in public and reduce psychological safety.
I assume logic will persuade, but emotions decide receptivity.
squares.try: Try: name the concern you’re hearing.

squares.text: I don’t notice who hasn’t spoken.
squares.try: Try: invite one quiet voice in.

squares.text: I change direction midstream without closing loops.
I treat objections as problems, not information.
I push solutions before fully understanding the context.
I value boldness over realism.
squares.try: Try: define “minimum viable” + do a risk check.

squares.text: I frame ideas too broadly and lose the room.
I optimise for winning, not for mutual progress.
squares.try: Try: “What does success look like for you?”

squares.text: I interrupt because I’m excited.
squares.try: Try: wait 3 seconds after someone finishes.

squares.text: I skip documentation and rely on memory.
I assume others can keep pace without scaffolding.
I escalate intensity when I feel blocked.
I underestimate operational constraints.
I over-index on the future and miss present reality.
I deliver feedback too bluntly.
I “sell” instead of co-creating.
squares.try: Try: offer 2 options and ask preference.

cards.label: INTJ / INTP
cards.description: Analytical and independent thinkers who enjoy analysing problem

squares.text: I stay quiet until I’m certain and miss influence windows.
squares.try: Try: share a draft POV early.

squares.text: I over-analyse and delay decisions.
I communicate too technically and lose stakeholders.
I assume others infer my intent.
squares.try: Try: state intent in one sentence.

squares.text: I minimise small talk and miss relationship currency.
I spot flaws quickly and sound negative.
I prefer working solo and forget to update others.
I hold high standards but don’t clarify expectations.
I avoid conflict until it becomes too big.
squares.try: Try: address early with one clear ask.

squares.text: I solve it in my head and forget to communicate the conclusion.
I explain the reasoning and overwhelm people.
squares.try: Try: lead with the decision, then rationale.

squares.text: I look distant when I’m just focused.
squares.try: Try: acknowledge the person before the problem.

squares.text: I assume logic is enough for buy-in.
squares.try: Try: ask “What matters most to you here?”

squares.text: I protect my time so much that I miss visibility.
I dislike vague requests and stall.
I notice patterns but don’t share them simply.
I avoid networking and lose allies.
I critique solutions without offering alternatives.
I keep feedback in my head.
I avoid asking for help.
I resist changing plans because I’ve optimized them.
squares.try: Try: “What did we learn?” then update.

squares.text: I assume others are less rigorous.
squares.try: Try: make your standard visible, not implied.

squares.text: I forget to celebrate progress.
I under-communicate priorities.
squares.try: Try: share top 3 outcomes for the week.

squares.text: I over-commit because I want to help.
I energise others but skip follow-through.
I avoid hard feedback to protect feelings.
I talk around the point to stay diplomatic.
I prioritise harmony and delay decisions.
I take responsibility for others’ emotions.
I interpret silence as disagreement.
I try to inspire when the team needs structure.
I soften “no” so much it becomes unclear.
squares.try: Try: “I can’t do X; I can do Y.”

squares.text: I share many ideas and overwhelm people.
I personalise critique and lose confidence.
I seek consensus and lose speed.
I focus on possibilities and miss risks.
I sense tension but avoid naming it.
I rely on enthusiasm, not clarity.
squares.try: Try: define success in one sentence.

squares.text: I spend time supporting others and neglect priorities.
I assume people know they’re valued.
I use too many qualifiers (“maybe/possibly”).
squares.try: Try: clear commitment or clear decline.

squares.text: I keep meetings positive but vague.
I avoid disagreeing publicly.
I jump in to rescue instead of coaching.
I communicate emotionally but miss evidence.
I worry about being liked and lose authority.
I assume alignment because the vibe feels good.
I keep my thoughts internal and others can’t read me.
squares.try: Try: share one sentence of intent.

squares.text: I avoid conflict and carry silent frustration.
I over-idealise how things “should” be and get stuck.
squares.try: Try: choose the next workable step.

squares.text: I take feedback personally.
squares.try: Try: extract 1 action and move on.

squares.text: I say yes to protect harmony.
I wait for the “right moment” to speak.
squares.try: Try: contribute in the first 10 minutes.

squares.text: I get drained by too many interactions.
squares.try: Try: set a boundary + recovery time.

squares.text: I assume people should “just know.”
I overthink and miss timely action.
I communicate indirectly to stay kind.
squares.try: Try: kind + direct in one sentence.

squares.text: I avoid visibility and miss opportunities.
I absorb team mood as my responsibility.
I hesitate to ask for help.
I struggle to prioritise when everything has meaning.
squares.try: Try: choose the top 1 outcome today.

squares.text: I keep feedback to myself.
squares.try: Try: SBI with care and clarity.

squares.text: I give more than I have capacity for.
I interpret tone strongly.
I get stuck in reflection.
squares.try: Try: take one small action now.

squares.text: I fear disappointing people and delay decisions.
I resist “selling” my ideas.
squares.try: Try: frame the benefit to others.

squares.text: I avoid messy conversations.
squares.try: Try: start with “I’d like to align…”

squares.text: I stay quiet when I disagree.
I over-polish messages.
I forget to celebrate progress.
I push structure quickly and others feel controlled.
squares.try: Try: ask for input before deciding.

squares.text: I assume others share my urgency.
I focus on execution and miss morale signals.
squares.try: Try: open with a check-in question.

squares.text: I correct in public and reduce safety.
I equate compliance with commitment.
I prioritise process over outcomes.
I delegate tasks without context.
I problem-solve before listening fully.
I get frustrated by ambiguity.
squares.try: Try: list what’s known vs unknown.

squares.text: I drive meetings but skip real alignment.
I focus on errors more than progress.
I assume “best practice” fits every case.
I micromanage to ensure quality.
I interpret pushback as resistance.
I speak too directly and people shut down.
squares.try: Try: soften the start; keep the message.

squares.text: I prioritise speed and miss stakeholder buy-in.
squares.try: Try: align early with key voices.

squares.text: I enforce rules without explaining rationale.
I expect reliability but don’t clarify deadlines.
I stick to the plan even when context changes.
squares.try: Try: “What did we learn?” then adjust.

squares.text: I assume silence = agreement.
I take on too much responsibility.
I prioritise “right” over “ready.”
I focus on near-term tasks and miss capability building.
I forget to ask what support people need.
I focus on details so much that the main message gets lost.
I hesitate to speak up and lose influence.
I rely on precedent when new approaches are needed.
I avoid conflict and carry it alone.
squares.try: Try: address early with one ask.

squares.text: I assume my work speaks for itself.
I over-check to avoid mistakes and slow delivery.
I get stuck on the “right way.”
I interpret change as risk and resist it.
squares.try: Try: ask what risk we’re managing.

squares.text: I communicate cautiously and sound unsure.
I say yes out of duty, not capacity.
I keep knowledge in my head.
I wait for full clarity before starting.
I delay delivery by chasing accuracy.
I notice issues but don’t raise them.
I under-communicate expectations.
I resist new tools and stick to familiar methods.
squares.try: Try: test one feature for a week.

squares.text: I avoid visibility and get overlooked.
I focus on tasks and miss stakeholder context.
I over-prepare messages.
I assume others don’t want feedback.
I internalise criticism and get discouraged.
squares.try: Try: clarify what success looks like.

squares.text: I struggle with ambiguous priorities.
squares.try: Try: ask for the top 1 priority.

squares.text: I avoid delegating because it’s faster to do myself.
I stay in my lane and miss cross-team impact.
squares.try: Try: ask “How does this affect others?”

squares.text: I speak fast and people miss the point.
I act quickly and skip alignment.
I chase what’s urgent and drop what’s important.
I improvise and forget documentation.
I jump into action before I understand context.
I assume others are fine with change.
I take risks without signalling them.
I steer with charisma but miss depth.
I avoid “boring details” that protect quality.
I prioritise fun over follow-through.
I resist planning and start too late.
I interrupt to keep energy up.
I respond in the moment and regret tone later.
I focus on immediate wins and miss consequences.
I wing it and under-prepare for stakeholders.
I push boundaries and others feel uncomfortable.
I avoid routine and lose consistency.
I fix problems instantly but don’t teach others.
I over-promise because I’m optimistic.
I prefer live chat and skip written clarity.
I go with energy and miss data.
I get bored and switch tasks.
I ignore small issues until they explode.
I assume silence means “all good.”
I keep thoughts to myself and others assume I’m disengaged.
I avoid planning and end up rushed.
I prefer doing over discussing and miss alignment.
I dislike meetings and lose influence.
I focus on the task and miss the emotional context.
I withdraw when conflict appears.
I wait until I have a perfect solution.
I under-explain and people feel uncertain.
I say little and others fill gaps with assumptions.
I resist structure and lose follow-through.
I procrastinate until pressure motivates me.
I avoid asking for help and slow progress.
I skip “admin steps” and create downstream issues.
squares.try: Try: do the minimum compliance steps.

squares.text: I shut down when “done” isn’t clear.
I communicate too briefly and people misread tone.
I fix symptoms and miss root cause.
I work independently and forget stakeholder sync.
I change approach mid-task without telling anyone.
I avoid presenting ideas and they don’t land.
squares.try: Try: share a short written proposal.

squares.text: I notice problems but don’t raise them.
I don’t celebrate progress and motivation drops.
I focus on details so the message gets lost.
I keep boundaries silently and others cross them.
I disengage when I feel controlled.
